pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit complex, multi-pointed polygonal geometries with relatively sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with large, high-complexity patches on the central flank transitioning to smaller, more simplified rectangular or oval geometries on the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage forms a continuous topological graph of intersecting pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate intersections. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-section, with slight narrowing observed in the segments separating the largest flank patches.
